title: Minimum degree conditions for removable matchings in $k$-connected graphs
summary: In 1969, Halin proved that every $k$-connected graph $G$ with minimum degree at least $k+1$ contains an edge $e$ such that $G-e$ is $k$-connected. As an edge is a matching of size one, it is natural to ask whether Halin's result extends to matchings of larger size, a question recently investigated by Li, Zhou, Fujita, and Mao. A matching $M$ of a $k$-connected graph $G$ is called \emph{$k$-removable} if $G-M$ is $k$-connected.
